description: This file defines a report parser class for auction totals in an Odoo/OpenERP module, including methods for retrieving auction data and statistics.

classes.name: auction_total_rml
classes.description: A report parser class for generating auction total reports, with methods to fetch auction details and statistics.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the parser and updates local context with report methods and data.

methods.name: get_auc_detail
methods.description: Retrieves auction details and associated dates for given auction lot objects.

methods.name: sum_taxes
methods.description: Counts auction lots for a specific auction ID.

methods.name: sold_item
methods.description: Counts unsold auction lots for a given object ID.

methods.name: sum_buyer
methods.description: Counts buyers associated with an auction ID.

methods.name: sum_seller
methods.description: Counts distinct sellers for an auction ID.

methods.name: sum_adj
methods.description: Sums the object prices for an auction ID.

methods.name: count_take
methods.description: Counts auction lots with 'ach_emp' marked as True for an auction ID.

methods.name: chek_paid
methods.description: Counts auction lots marked as paid or OK for an auction ID.

methods.name: check_paid_seller
methods.description: Sums seller prices for auction lots not fully paid for an auction ID.

methods.name: sum_credit
methods.description: Sums buyer prices for an auction ID.

methods.name: sum_debit_buyer
methods.description: Sums buyer prices for an auction ID, defaulting to 0 if None.

methods.name: sum_debit
methods.description: Sums seller prices for a given auction ID.

methods.name: sum_credit_seller
methods.description: Sums seller prices for auction lots in the current object list for a given auction ID.

methods.name: sum_minadj
methods.description: Sums 'lot_est1' (minimum estimate) for auction lots in the current object list.

methods.name: sum_maxadj
methods.description: Sums 'lot_est2' (maximum estimate) for auction lots in the current object list.

methods.name: sum_buyer_paid
methods.description: Counts auction lots marked as 'paid' for an auction ID.

methods.name: count_comm
methods.description: Counts auction lots with non-null 'obj_comm' for an auction ID.
